## What landed

- `capture.rs` — `/logs/agent` ST4 copy-out (kernel-mediated `cp_out`
  after agent end, before verify; `/work` alias refused) hashed into
  `trajectory.native_log`; post-hoc ATIF at the Harbor pin (absence a
  reported attribute; publication input = the receipt-index
  transcript); `hh-integrity-bundle/1` recomputing manifest; REQ-XC-207
  reconciliation → `inconclusive{infra:unreceipted_call}`; ST4
  version/tree re-probe → `harness_self_modified`.
- `smoke.rs` — `hh-smoke/write-file` task + three scripted recordings
  (own tool schema + streaming mode) + `hh-smoke-battery/1`
  (`keying: sequence`, `on_divergence: serve_recorded`); the offline
  records-in checker for every §5.7 variant; `egress.probe` + AG5;
  model-socket assertion; `n/a{endpoint}`; the pure §5.8 classifier
  with records-in recompute.
- `check-hosting-offline.sh` grep battery + CI step; live smoke/build
  legs `#[ignore = "live — ADR-0363: …"]` — W1 (R6.32) executes at $0.

## Deviations

~4.0k lines vs ≤1600 recorded (AMEND precedent); one commit for both
stages; admission records gained `egress.probe`; 3 pre-existing clippy
